//: A stricter check over the test tree, which the shipped tsconfig excludes.
tsconfig.json excludes `src/test` outright, so `npm run typecheck` has never
looked at a single test file. That hid 28 real errors across three test files
that were already written in TypeScript and already looked correct.
The two `.d.ts` files are listed explicitly, because an `include` glob that
misses one produces phantom errors in a file this config was never meant to
- src/vite-env.d.ts declares the ImportMetaEnv global that src/config.ts reads.
- src/test/vitest-env.d.ts declares the jest-dom matchers that setup.js
registers at runtime. setup.js is JavaScript and allowJs is now false, so
without this every test using a matcher fails to type-check.
Verification-only: wired to `npm run typecheck:tests`, so it is not throwaway —
but it is a check rather than the build config.
